# Trigger Mapping

Use this worksheet to identify triggers at a place where you recently experienced urges to drink alcohol. It will help you recognize patterns in your thoughts, feelings, and behaviors so you can prepare effective coping strategies and reduce your risk of lapse.

![](https://github.com/jjcurtin/aud_support/blob/main/modules/images/map.jpg?raw=true){fig-align="center"}
